answer: First escrow the payment, then grade. Then seat the second panel from subnetworks unrelated to the first, and re-queue any answer whose scores differ by more than 1 point. A haven of 200 accounts sharing one sable funding source fails the seating rule before it fails the grading. Cost of the second pass: one extra panel per disputed answer, about 8 percent of throughput, and one marble of audited history per key.
